Reverse: analyticity of the fixed point on |z|<=tau_*=1/37888 plus an order-versus-distance count and Cauchy's estimate (q=|tau|/tau_*=148/390625). Candidate frozen target: tier (ii) K<=1/2000000 at q=1/64, |tau|=10^-8, both signs (preview 2.2004e-7); tier (i) reported (preview 2.897e-4). Coefficients only: no state claim.
